NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author replied with two screenshots and an apology but did not push any new commits, so the code is the same as when the feedback was given.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ❌  | No new push, so nothing in the PR changed in response to the feedback. |
| ❌  | The AI-policy feedback is unanswered: the comment only apologizes and does not say what was fixed or confirm the author understands the change. |
| ⚠️  | Screenshots were posted in a comment, but the PR description still has the "[Upload your screenshot or video here]" placeholder. |
| ℹ️  | PR #39758 (open, from another contributor) fixes the same issue in the same two files, and its last maintainer comment asks @shubham-padia to look at it. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and give more feedback, and consider whether #39758 should be the one that moves forward.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! Please move them into the PR description, and tell us in your own words what the change does and what you tested. Please also read the [AI use policy](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/contributing.html#ai-use-policy-and-guidelines) and push any changes you make as updated commits.
```
